Track utilization without nagging your team
Most firms only learn a project went over budget after the month closes. We pipe time entries, scope, and rates into one view so you see margin slipping in real time, not in retrospect.
Time entries that finish themselves
Calendar events, commits, Slack threads, and Linear updates roll into draft timesheets your team approves in two clicks. Friday-night catch-up sessions disappear.
Resource allocation across concurrent clients
See who is overbooked, who has slack, and which retainer is eating someone's week. Reassign before a deadline slips, not after a client emails.
Staffing decisions backed by real numbers
A studio juggling six concurrent clients needs to know who is free Tuesday, who is burning out, and which engagement has room for the new senior hire. We pull that signal out of your existing tools.
Skill and capacity matching
Match new project requirements against current availability, role, and recent project history. The next staffing call takes minutes instead of three Slack threads.
Margin alerts before they hurt
When actual hours pass 70% of scoped budget, project leads get a heads-up. Conversations with clients about scope happen early, not after the overrun.
Want a utilization audit for your firm?
30 minutes. We map where billable hours go missing, where staffing decisions get made on gut feel, and where the next month of margin can be recovered.
Request Your Professional Services Blueprint
Projects to invoices, without the spreadsheet bridge
Most firms have project data in one tool, time in another, and invoicing in a third. The gaps cost a week of admin per month and a slice of revenue per quarter.
Before vs after we ship
Client portal that handles itself
Clients can see project status, approve milestones, and download invoices without emailing your PM:
Status snapshots: auto-generated from your project data weekly.
Approval flows: milestone sign-off triggers the next invoice.
Document drop: deliverables surfaced in one place, not buried in email.
Pipeline to delivery in one record
A sold deal in your CRM becomes a staffed project, a budget, and a billing schedule, with no re-keying:
Scope import: SOW line items become project tasks automatically.
Rate cards: applied per role so margin math is live, not quarterly.
Cut the admin tax your senior people pay
Your $200/hr principal shouldn't be reformatting Excel rows. We move status reports, expense coding, and weekly rollups off human plates and into workflows that run quietly.
No more swivel-chair updates
Project status, billing data, and CRM stages stay in sync across Harvest, Monday, HubSpot, and QuickBooks, without an ops person copying numbers between tabs.
Invoicing that matches reality
Approved hours flow into draft invoices each Monday. Finance reviews, sends, and reconciles in the same place, not across three exports.
Don't take it from us
Hear it from the operators we shipped for.
Real founders. Real cameras. No scripts. Different industries, same agent stack.
